ModMetaData.name: Rotmeth Renew
ModMetaData.author: troopersmith1, winggar - 1.6 port by nelim
ModMetaData.description:
An alcohol fermented from meat, from the Elder Scrolls series.
Rotmeth was the ritual drink of the Bosmer of Valenwood, who had sworn never to eat anything plant-based. It finds its use on the Rim too: fermenting disguises the origin of the meat, which lets unscrupulous leaders make use of human and insect meat without their colonists ever finding out.
Research rotmeth after brewing, make the wort from 25 raw meat of any kind at the vanilla brewery, then let it ferment nine days in a fermenting barrel.
REQUIRES [SYR] Processor Framework
The fermenting barrel is that framework's building, not the vanilla one, and the nine-day process is added to it by patch. Without the framework the wort has nowhere to go. Use the version maintained by ViralReaction, which supports 1.6: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3210544395
A 1.6 port of a mod that stopped at 1.3, taken over without changes. The original defNames are kept, so a save moves between the two without losing anything, and the original is declared incompatible below.
Available in English and French.
CREDIT
The drink, its recipe and its artwork are troopersmith1 and winggar's work, from a request by daemonfool on the Ludeon forums.
No licence was declared, and the mod has not been updated since the 1.3 cycle. It is republished here under the usual convention for abandoned mods: full credit, and removal on request. If either author would rather this port did not exist, say so and it comes down.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2039474581
